meta.title: Como-Anchored Perth Home Model — baseline forecast
meta.rounding: expected = round-half-up to nearest $1,000 of the weighted scenario average
meta.note: Scenario anchor paths are the calibrated output of the city VECM spine plus an analyst overlay (iron ore, Simandou, NG/CGT, undersupply). scenario_model.py regenerates the expected path and derived metrics from these anchors and self-verifies against this file.

macro.cash_rate_note: Held at 17 Jun 2026 meeting after Feb/Mar/May 2026 hikes; hawkish bias retained.
macro.iron_ore_note: ~US$100/t late-Jun 2026, softening from US$111 May avg; ~US$95/t 2026 average consensus; Simandou ramp bearish into 2027.

buy_window.label: 2027 soft patch
buy_window.rationale: Expected path flattens (not a crash); bear trough ~$930k late-27/mid-28. With $800k at 0% the carrying cost of waiting is ~nil, so a patient, opportunistic stance is optimal.
triggers: Perth monthly growth flat/negative for 2+ consecutive months
Advertised stock rising back toward the 5-year average
Iron ore sustained below US$85/t with rising FIFO unemployment
Days-on-market lengthening past ~20 days in target suburbs

scenario_assumptions.base: RBA holds 4.35% into 2027 then cuts from ~mid-27; iron ore ~US$95/t 2026 easing to ~US$85-90 in 2027; undersupply (vacancy ~0.5-0.7%, completions <22k) puts a floor under prices; NG/CGT drag ~0.6-1.0ppt concentrated in investor stock. Net: flat-to-modest growth, re-acceleration from 2028.
scenario_assumptions.bear: Westpac-style renewed hiking (Aug/Sep 2026) plus iron ore <US$85/t and Simandou volumes arriving faster; FIFO unemployment rises; investor demand cut by NG/CGT bites harder. Trough ~-7% late-27/mid-28; undersupply prevents a 2014-style crash.
scenario_assumptions.bull: RBA cuts in 2027, migration stays >2% with completions still short; construction-cost relief; resources hold. Prices re-accelerate; family-corridor school suburbs lead.
